crossRefs.note: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
“If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

translations.web: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
translations.bsb: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
translations.kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands
translations.asv: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.
